title: Orgiast: Internal Events & Creative Production
content_html:
This is the recruitment information page for Orgiast Co., Ltd. We provide information on internships, new graduate recruitment, career recruitment, related events, benefits, an environment where you can take on challenges, and how to apply. Our company actively supports individuals who have curiosity, a desire for self-improvement, and a willingness to learn.

Job Openings

  • Sales Position (New Graduates / Mid-Career)

    As a sales representative at an event production company, you will be responsible for proposing, receiving orders, and providing post-event follow-up for corporate internal events, award systems, and package plans. Based at the Tokyo Head Office, you can work fully remotely 5 days a week. You will first learn the approach to planning and the proposal process by accompanying senior colleagues.

    Work Location: Tokyo Head Office

    Conditions: 5 days a week, fully remote

    Job Description: Propose packaged plans for internal events and award systems to corporate clients. You will be responsible for client consultations, creating proposals and estimates, coordinating with the internal production team, and conducting post-event reviews. Sales activities are primarily online, and you will visit client sites or event venues as needed.

    Salary: Monthly salary from 200,000 yen or more, with a probationary period, and salary increases based on ability.

    Benefits: 5 days a week, fully remote work; probationary period applies; salary increases based on ability.

    Required Documents for Application: Resume, and Career History (for mid-career applicants only)

  • Event Production Experienced Personnel

    We are seeking individuals who have been involved in events and wish to utilize their experience at Orgiast.
    Any form of involvement is welcome.
    (Creator, Site Supervisor, Site Staff, Production Staff, Director… Others also acceptable)
    We will discuss your experience during the interview and assign you tasks in your area of expertise.

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Conditions: Individuals with previous experience in events

    Job Description: Varies depending on the assigned field.

    Salary: To be discussed based on role and ability

    Required Documents for Application: Resume, and past production work samples if available

  • Home-Based Assistant

    We are seeking individuals who can perform administrative tasks entirely from home.

    (Main Duties)
    Duties include a wide range of computer-based administrative tasks and data entry from home, allowing you to choose work that suits you.
    *It is also possible to be involved in events, such as as an assistant director for event production.

    [Manual Provided / Peace of mind for beginners]
    A manual for the work is available, so as long as you follow it, the tasks are not difficult. Even those new to administrative work or working from home can start with peace of mind.

    [Immediate Consultation Available]
    If you encounter issues you cannot resolve or have questions, you can immediately consult with your online team leader.

    [Fully Remote Work]
    All procedures are handled fully remotely, so you will never need to visit the office. Interviews can be conducted online!

    [Balance Your Private Life]
    Work is possible on weekdays and weekends alike!
    You can take on work according to your schedule.

    Many of our team members are working alongside their main job, balancing housework, childcare, and work, or starting without prior experience.
    We look forward to your application!

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Conditions: Must be able to perform PC work and have a home network environment.

    Job Description: Includes computer-based administrative tasks, data entry, and many other duties.

    Salary: Hourly wage 1,100 yen or more. The hourly rate is an estimate.
    Compensation is determined per task, and the total amount for the tasks you complete will be paid monthly.
    *Payment will be made by the 5th of the month following the end of the billing month (end of month), via transfer to your designated financial institution.

    Required Documents for Application: Please contact us via the telephone number listed on the website or by email.

  • System Engineer / Programmer (SE / PG)

    In-house package product development / Internal system development


    Specifically...
    ・Participate in the development process from basic design to program implementation, system testing, and production release.
    ・Report on the performance, progress, and issues of assigned tasks.
    ・Investigate, research, and develop solutions for technical challenges.
    ・Furthermore, participate in project teams for new product development.

    Required Skills
    ・Experience in system development work.
    ・Development experience in languages such as JAVA, .NET, PHP, etc.
    ・Experience developing Android/iOS apps, etc., welcome
    ・Experience developing with AWS, Salesforce, PRA (AI), etc., or those eager to learn these technologies, very welcome
    ・MCP, basic/applied qualifications very welcome
    *Please apply if even one of the above applies to you.

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Job Description: In-house system construction / implementation of new programs

    Salary: We will discuss based on your career history and experience.

    Benefits: Various social insurance (health, employment, workers' compensation)
    Remote work enablement – necessary hardware and software provided

    Required Documents for Application: Resume

  • Event Planner

    You will be responsible for event planning. We are looking for someone skilled at creating plans that meet client requests and devising interesting proposals.

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Conditions: Experience in creating proposals/presentation documents.

    Job Description: Meetings (client interviews) / proposal creation

    Salary: Depending on the project and proposal content

    Required Documents for Application: Past production track record

  • Creator

    We are recruiting subcontractors in various fields.

    ・Video Creator
    ・Web Creator
    ・Graphic Creator
    ・Sound/Lighting Operator
    ・Special Effects Operator
    ・Video Equipment Operator

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Required Documents for Application: Past production track record

  • Creative Director

    You will be responsible for managing the production progress and quality control of deliverables.

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Conditions: Experience in one or more of the following areas: Web, video, graphic design

    Required Documents for Application: Past production track record

  • Event Director

    Together with our employees, you will direct the production of in-house events.

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Conditions: Experience as a director or stage manager

    Job Description: Meetings, negotiations with venues, planning, direction, scripts, manual creation, progress management of other production materials, on-site progress management, etc.

    Required Documents for Application: Past production track record

  • Web Creator

    You will be responsible for the design and PR measures of our company website and web services.

    Work Location: Tokyo Head Office / Osaka Branch Office

    Conditions: Fully remote, 3 or more days per week; experienced applicants only

    Salary: Negotiable based on ability

  • Remote Internship (Students / Long-term)

    Would you like to pursue and create the “optimal creative for our customers” together with our staff in charge of overall event production creativity?
    This is a job that brings inspiration through creativity. Through this internship, please experience the image of career advancement. You will gain experience as an Event Assistant Director, Sales Assistant, etc. By engaging in practical work, your image of employment will become clearer. In addition, depending on your ability, you will work with employees in responsible positions and participate in decision-making, allowing you to experience a vision of career advancement.

    This internship is a remote internship, and there is no need to come into the office. You can gain work experience at home.
    ■ Required Equipment
    ・Personal computer
    ・Internet environment
    ・Internal meetings use Zoom; chat uses Line

    Time: 9:00 - 18:00 (Weekdays) 8 hours of work (1 hour break) *Consultation available
    Days Off: Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays
    Salary: Hourly wage 1,000 yen *Daily report required
    Salary Increase: In accordance with the Company's internal regulations (based on gross profit amount + improvement score)
    Work Location: Home (online) – Fully online, no need to come to the office
    Insurance: Employment insurance available; no social insurance (for students) *For non-students, separate rules apply

    Work Location: Nationwide, primarily Tokyo and Osaka

    Conditions: Long-term, 3 months or more *Consultation possible

    Job Description：
    [Sales Planning] Creating plans for online events, creating proposal materials, etc. Not only routine tasks, but also creating proposals by envisioning what appears attractive and beneficial to customers. You will also carry out proposals to clients and implement them.

    [Event Assistant Director] You will handle production direction tasks, support, quality checks, and other creative work.

    [System Engineer] Correcting programs created with in-house Google Apps Script, creating new systems, etc. *Please mainly work on improving our internal systems.

    Required Documents for Application: Resume

Application Method

After reviewing the above recruitment details, please submit your entry. We will contact you later by phone or email.
Business Hours: Weekdays 10:00~18:00 Recruitment Contact: Yamanaka
